```text
commit 02d9f643f3435d012421f762f402acceadb7e272
Author: Da-Wei Lee <daviddwlee84@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Apr 25 08:33:01 2026 +0800

    ansible+chezmoi: discordChannel prompt switches Discord between flatpak (default) and .deb
    
    Discord's .deb does not ship an apt-source postinst, so the in-app
    updater pops a "Must be your lucky day, there's a new update!" modal
    on every release that requires manual download + dpkg -i. Flatpak's
    com.discordapp.Discord on Flathub auto-updates via `flatpak update`,
    no modal. Make Flatpak the default for new installs while preserving
    the .deb path as an opt-in for users who don't want a Flatpak runtime.
    
    Plumbing (per CLAUDE.md cross-file rules for new chezmoi prompts):
    - .chezmoi.toml.tmpl: new promptChoiceOnce(discordChannel,
      flatpak|deb|none) — Linux only; macOS pinned to "none" since Discord
      on Mac is a Brewfile cask concern.
    - Dockerfile: new ARG CHEZMOI_DISCORD_CHANNEL=none + --promptChoice flag
      (Docker test images stay GUI-less by default).
    - scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py: PROMPTS entry + extend
      _build_chezmoi_init_argv to emit --promptChoice for any non-basics
      choice prompt (was hardcoded to profile only — now generic).
    - run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl: pipe .discordChannel
      through to ansible as discord_channel=<value> via EXTRA_VARS, gated
      on profile=ubuntu_desktop.
    - gui_apps_linux/tasks/main.yml: rewrite Discord block as a
      channel-selector. set_fact defaults discord_channel=flatpak so the
      role still works when invoked outside the chezmoi flow (direct
      ansible-playbook). flatpak path uses community.general.flatpak +
      flatpak_remote at method:user (no sudo for the install itself; sudo
      only for `apt install flatpak` if the runtime is missing).
    
    Doctor reports discordChannel parity clean across all three files.
    The pre-existing installDotnet / installJsCli drift is untouched.
    
    Switching an existing .deb-Discord machine to Flatpak: set
    `discordChannel = "flatpak"` in ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml,
    `chezmoi apply --tags gui_apps`, validate, then
    `sudo apt remove discord` to drop the old .deb. Both .desktop entries
    can coexist briefly so the migration is reversible.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```

```bash
`daviddwlee84/agent-skills`, which points `npx skills` at the repo's
`.agents/skills/` directory. Upstream keeps our three skills under
`skills/local/` and `skills/vendor/` — `.agents/skills/` only contains
`find-skills` + `skill-creator`, so `just bootstrap-skills` (and the
chezmoi run-script that mirrors it) printed:

    mkdocs-site-bootstrap, project-knowledge-harness

per the rule documented in docs/tools/agent-skills.md:179 — add the
explicit `/skills` suffix so the installer looks at the right directory.

- skills-lock.json: three entries (agent-history-hygiene,
  mkdocs-site-bootstrap, project-knowledge-harness). computedHash left
  untouched since the hash is over skill folder contents, not the
  source URL.

  is from vercel-labs/skills and is NOT affected — left as-is.

`.chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_40_install_global_skills.sh.tmpl`
reads `.source` verbatim and passes it to `npx skills add`, so no code
change is needed in the install script.

EOF
)"
```

```bash
chezmoi: gate discordChannel prompt on ubuntu_desktop profile

Previously the prompt was gated on `eq .chezmoi.os "linux"`, so
ubuntu_server installs were asked a GUI-app question they can't
act on (the run-script already gates the ansible pass-through on
`ubuntu_desktop`, so a server's answer was silently dropped).
Move the gate up to the prompt itself.

.chezmoi.toml.tmpl gotcha worth capturing: the condition must
reference `$profile` (the local variable captured from
`promptChoiceOnce` at line 23), NOT `.profile` — at init time the
file is producing the `[data]` section that defines `profile`, so
`.profile` is not yet in scope and the eq check would always be
false. Added an inline comment so the next person doesn't relearn
this by trial-and-error.

Also refreshed the dotfiles_init.py wizard description from
"Linux only" to "ubuntu_desktop only (macOS → Brewfile cask,
ubuntu_server → skipped)" to match the new semantics. Doctor
reports discordChannel parity clean; pre-existing installDotnet /
installJsCli drift is unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git status
```
